summary: Iteration 31 (frontend + backend, 390x844, preview URL 7d86e238...): checked the Travoo light UI redesign and its regressions. Backend: the new test_iter31_ui_redesign.py plus test_iter28_mode.py ran 18 of 18 passing. Register rejects the mobile numbers 12345, 5876543210, an 11-digit number and letters with a 400 error. An empty, missing or valid mobile registers. The mode switch round trip works. Frontend: every requested item passes. The splash shows the pin, 'Travoo', the tagline and the scenic car image. Auth works: Welcome back, Create Your Account, the eye toggle, the invalid-mobile error, then success with an empty or valid mobile, and the redirect to /mode. Choose Mode shows both cards. On Passenger Home all 4 tile/link routes go to the right place. The active tab is green rgb(31,170,75), and there are 5 passenger tabs with no Offer tab. Find a Ride works: the error, swap, and /search, and Popular Routes and Recent Searches repeat the search. Driver mode shows tabs home/trips/earnings/messages/account. The Become a Travoo Driver routing works for rent, both and carpool, and Continue is disabled when nothing is chosen. Driver registration: the 1-2-3 progress, the blue Next rgb(21,101,216), step 1 and step 2 checks, Rent and Book preselected on step 3 for service=both, and the green 'Submit for Verification' (not submitted). The approved driver dashboard shows all elements. The online toggle round trip works, the services panel opens and closes, and all 8 tiles/links go to the right place. Availability: the outstation toggle survives a reload and matches the dashboard toggle; add, edit and delete (confirm dialog) work, and items show the Active badge. Profile and mode sheet: Switch is disabled for the current mode and blue. Switching driver->passenger->driver changes the tabs and goes to Home. The documents and vehicles rows are present. Regression: the hire accept goes to /hire/HIR-..; the booking shows on driver My Trips (confirmed, Rs 450) and in the passenger's notifications. Admin login reaches /admin/dashboard. No blocking bugs; only minor UX points below.

minor.issue: The mobile number is not checked for uniqueness. Two accounts can register with the same phone, which may clash with OTP login later.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Offer a ride' outline button in the 3-button row is cut off to 'Offer a ri...' at 390px
A carpool-approved driver (driver@travoo.in) still sees 'Become a Travoo Driver'. The 'Offer a Ride' (carpool) option is unchecked and shows no approved state. Driver Only is preselected by default.

issues: An approved LOCAL driver (whose dashboard shows 'Verified Driver') sees 'Not submitted' + 'New driver' under the name. This badge only reflects carpool verification, which is confusing. Passengers also see 'Not submitted / New driver'.
The green register button says 'Create account', not 'Register' as in the design (minor wording).
It has no 'Hi, name' greeting or bell, unlike the approved dashboard header.
Every upcoming schedule shows the 'Active' badge even before it starts (e.g. tomorrow). Consider 'Upcoming' vs 'Active'.
The tab badge still showed 1 right after the passenger opened the Notifications tab.

action_items: Optional: make the driver-offer-ride label fit, or shorten it to 'Offer', in DriverHome
Optional: on Profile, show the local-driver approval (Verified Driver) when the pro profile is approved, and hide 'Not submitted' for passengers
Optional: on DriverHome, show carpool as already approved for carpool-verified drivers
Optional: check for duplicate phone numbers on /auth/register
critical_code_review_comments: In auth.tsx, the register code keeps only the last 10 digits of the phone (replace(/\D/g,'').slice(-10)). A pasted 12-digit '91XXXXXXXXXX' is accepted, but any longer junk is silently cut to its last 10 digits instead of being rejected.

In (tabs)/_layout.tsx, a native-tabs 'notifications' Trigger is hidden for drivers. That is fine, but the 'driver-requests' screen is still registered and always hidden, so its open-requests polling (loadRequests every 15s) now only feeds a hidden tab badge. The polling could be removed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (minor UX notes only)

seed_data_creation: TEST users from ui_setup_iter29.py (drv/pax/fresh) plus 2 TEST_ UI-registered users. All were deleted by id/email. The demo modes are confirmed: driver@ = driver, passenger@ = passenger. While testing Find a Ride, one search (Mysuru -> Bengaluru) was added to passenger@travoo.in's Recent Searches. It is left in place; the user can clear it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup: cd /app/backend/tests && python3 ui_setup_iter29.py create && python3 ui_setup_iter29.py hire 10:00; TEST user password is Passw0rd!x; cleanup with python3 ui_setup_iter29.py cleanup. The language screen comes first (language-continue-button). Use .filter(visible=True) for the tab-* buttons. Driver tabs: tab-home, tab-trips, tab-earnings, tab-messages, tab-account. Requests is reached from dash-tile-requests (/hire/requests). Language picker in registration: pro-lang-dropdown, then pro-lang-kannada. For step 3 of registration, upload docs via the API (/driver/documents/{licence_front,licence_back,id_proof}).
